entities.name: Minimization of service interruption
entities.description: Enables UE to obtain service from a PLMN offering disaster roaming when a disaster condition applies to the UE's determined PLMN.

entities.name: Disaster roaming wait range
entities.description: A provisioned range used by UE to generate random timer values before initiating disaster roaming registration.

entities.name: Disaster return wait range
entities.description: A provisioned range used by UE to generate random timer values before initiating registration after disaster condition ends.

entities.name: Disaster roaming timer
entities.description: Timer started with random value from disaster roaming wait range to delay disaster roaming registration.

entities.name: Disaster return timer
entities.description: Timer started with random value from disaster return wait range to delay registration after disaster condition ends.

entities.name: Registration procedure for disaster roaming services
entities.description: Registration procedure performed by UE to obtain disaster roaming services.

entities.name: Emergency registration
entities.description: Registration procedure initiated when UE needs to request emergency PDU session during disaster roaming.

entities.name: 5GMM-DEREGISTERED
entities.description: UE state where MINT-related data is preserved in non-volatile memory.

entities.name: Disaster condition ended
entities.description: Condition indicating that the disaster situation has concluded.

entities.name: Emergency PDU session
entities.description: Emergency data session that affects disaster roaming registration timing.

relations.description: MINT procedure uses disaster roaming wait range for timer generation.
MINT procedure uses disaster return wait range for timer generation.
MINT procedure starts disaster roaming timer when wait range is available.
MINT procedure starts disaster return timer when wait range is available.
Timer expiration triggers disaster roaming registration procedure.
Timer expiration triggers registration procedure after disaster condition ends.
Emergency PDU session presence affects disaster roaming timer behavior.
Emergency registration can be initiated while disaster roaming timer is running.
Disaster condition ending triggers start of disaster return timer.
MINT data is preserved when UE enters 5GMM-DEREGISTERED state.
